indicator.definition: Number of occupied housing units whose main wall material is "Cadjan or palmyrah", as recorded by the Census of Population and Housing 2024. Each housing unit is counted in exactly one category. Published by DCS for DS divisions and districts only; there is no GN breakdown.
indicator.name: Occupied housing units by main wall material: Cadjan or palmyrah
